description: Ouroboros plugin hooks — URL security, code formatting, session lifecycle, output capture, choice logging, and message collection

PreToolUse.description: Block dangerous URLs before fetch: non-HTTPS protocols, internal/private IPs, direct IP access

PostToolUse.description: Auto-format written files by extension: ruff (py), prettier/eslint (ts), rustfmt (rs), trailing whitespace (md), shfmt/shellcheck (sh)

SessionStart.description: Inject dev/STATUS.md, recent git activity, and restored conversation context into session

PreCompact.description: Produce compact change summary (recent commits, diff stats, session name suggestion) for compaction context

UserPromptSubmit.description: Append user message to ~/.claude/user-messages.jsonl for batch friction analysis (append-only telemetry)

PermissionRequest.description: Append permission choice to ~/.claude/choice-log.jsonl for permission pattern analysis (append-only telemetry)

SubagentStop.description: Capture ouroboros agent output to .captures/ for evaluation pipeline (opt-in via OUROBOROS_CAPTURE=1)
